skill.enemy.undead.grasping_strike.rule: Deal 9 plus level raw damage to the effective recipient.

animationBeats.pose: The wight turns its bare skull toward the party and fixes on the target with a slow, certain turn.
Both arms rise and reach, fingers splaying wide for the grasp.
The grip closes on the target's nearest limb and the whole body leans into the pull.
The target is wrenched off balance as the strike lands at full extension.
The wight releases and settles back into a low, patient ready stance.

skill.enemy.undead.grasping_strike.framing: Keep the full figure, both hands, the target line and the impact effect inside the battle safe frame for every beat.

text.firstObservation: The tomb wight moves the way its own funeral procession once did: slow, certain, unhurried by anything the living party can do.

intentTells.skill.enemy.undead.grasping_strike: It raises both bony arms and fixes on the weakest stance in the party, fingers spreading for a grasping strike.

art.framing: Entire skeletal figure, both hands, grave wrappings and impact effect remain inside the battle safe frame.
